Name: Eyeless Void Chickens
Author: GraceTheChicken
Description:
This mod changes void chickens and chicks from having eyes to having no eyes. I was bored so I made this, and now they're creepier.

[b]Installation
[/b][b]RECOMMENDED:[/b] Backup your Void Chicken.xnb and Babyvoid chicken.xnb files.
1. Unzip the file.
2. Navigate to your [code]Stardew Valley\Content\Animals[/code] folder.
3. Copy and paste the Void Chicken.xnb and Babyvoid chicken.xnb files into the folder
4. Replace the files.
5. Open Stardew Valley and enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Want a void chicken with no eyes? Use this.
